answer: An agent economy can organize each service grove around refundable stake: every identity must lock $100 for 30 days to receive one job slot at a time. Viewed through this prism, influence depends on committed capital, so splitting into aliases creates no extra slots per dollar. Even at the zenith of demand, an attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous slots must immobilize $100,000 and bear its financing cost for the full month.
